description: This PHP source file defines the class 'FormatWithLicenseId' which implements 'ValueFormatter'. It is part of the 'OrangeHRM' system, specifically within the maintenance access strategy for formatting values with license IDs. The class fetches a 'License' entity via a 'LicenseService' and returns its name if found.

classes.name: FormatWithLicenseId
classes.description: Implements value formatting by retrieving and returning the name of a license given its ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Fetches the license by ID and returns its name or null if not found.

methods.name: getLicenseService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the LicenseService instance.
